plain_language: 如果账户里没有任何超过目标而需要卖出的持仓，按原有买入规则把新钱买成整百份；如果确实需要卖出，但按原交易单位连100份都卖不出，现金仍等到下一次预定周决策。
strategy_layer: shared cash allocation and weekly ETF holding adjustment; no strategy authority changed
fixed_buy_sell_quantity: Purchases remain multiples of 100; required P1 sales remain rounded down to multiples of 100 and limited by released holdings. No arbitrary smaller sale or tail liquidation is generated.
new_branch_difference: The old policy deferred every triggered zero-whole-lot sale, including no holdings or both holdings under target. The new adapter checks actual positive excess against the half-target before choosing original P0 buys or deferral.

zero_start_three_weeks.weekly_buy_orders: A100+B100 each week, all at artificial price 1

checks: Each week deposited once; repeat deposit and repeat decision rejected at policy guards without changing account money state, so these rejected attempts do not appear in dated-ledger audit counts
Original P0 planning and opening-order validation used for all new purchases
Dated ledger applied each purchase and verified cash, holdings, fees and account value
Genuine excess below a legal whole sale retained cash without any order
Original historical five cases were reused without rerun or overwrite
limits: All prices, calendar permissions and fees are artificial. This is not a qualified historical ETF comparison, actual execution proof, or trading authorization.
mechanical_failure: First attempt stopped in disk identity preflight because plist fields use integer 0/1; recorded before repair, then second attempt passed.
